# On the World Map

> > Comprehensive collection of tourist maps, city guides, park trails, campus layouts, and geographic reference maps for locations across California and the United States.

On the World Map provides detailed, printable maps for travelers, students, and residents exploring cities like Los Angeles, San Diego, San Francisco, and Sacramento. The site specializes in California destinations, featuring street maps, recreational areas, transit systems, and campus guides.

## Key Topics

- California tourist maps
- City street maps
- Park and trail maps
- Campus maps and layouts
- Geographic reference maps
- Transit and light rail maps
- Recreational area guides
- San Mateo locations
- Los Angeles attractions
- San Diego destinations
- Sacramento area maps
- California state parks
- Road and scenic drive maps
- Airport terminal maps
- Downtown walking maps

## California City Tourist Maps

- [Sacramento Area Tourist Map](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/sacramento/sacramento-area-tourist-map.html): Tourist map showing Sacramento area attractions and roads
- [Los Angeles Zoo Map](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/los-angeles/los-angeles-zoo-map.html): Visitor guide and layout map of Los Angeles Zoo
- [17-Mile Drive Map](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/monterey/17-mile-drive-map.html): Scenic drive road map of 17-Mile Drive on Monterey Peninsula
- [Downtown Redding Walking Map](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/redding/downtown-redding-walking-map.html): Pedestrian walking map of downtown Redding, California
- [Mammoth Lakes Regional Map](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/mammoth-lakes/mammoth-lakes-regional-map.html): Regional visitor map of Mammoth Lakes area, California

## Parks and Recreation Areas

- [Coyote Point Map | San Mateo | Coyote Point Recreation Area](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/san-mateo/coyote-point-park-map.html): Map of Coyote Point Recreation Area in San Mateo, California
- [Pismo State Beach Map](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/pismo-beach/pismo-state-beach-map.html): Map of Pismo State Beach with campground locations
- [Central Park Map | San Mateo](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/san-mateo/central-park-map.html): Trail and facilities map of Central Park in San Mateo
- [Alviso Marina County Park Maps | San Jose](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/san-jose/alviso-marina-map.html): Trail map of Alviso Marina County Park in San Jose
- [History Park Maps | San Jose](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/san-jose/history-park-map.html): Printable tourist map of History Park in San Jose

## Campus and University Maps

- [Occidental College Campus Map - Oxy](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/los-angeles/occidental-college-campus-map.html): Campus map of Occidental College (Oxy) in Los Angeles
- [Stanford University Parking Map](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/palo-alto/stanford-parking-map.html): Parking lots map for Stanford University campus in Palo Alto
- [Los Angeles Valley College Campus Map - LAVC](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/los-angeles/lavc-campus-map.html): Campus map of Los Angeles Valley College (LAVC)

## Transportation and Transit

- [Sacramento RT Light Rail Map](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/sacramento/sacramento-light-rail-map.html): Sacramento RT light rail transit map with station guide
- [San Diego Airport Terminal 2 Map](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/san-diego/san-diego-airport-terminal-2-map.html): Layout map of San Diego Airport Terminal 2

## Downtown and Street Maps

- [Capitol Mall Map - Sacramento](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/sacramento/capitol-mall-map.html): Interactive street map of Capitol Mall in downtown Sacramento
- [Noyo Harbor Map - Fort Bragg](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/fort-bragg/noyo-harbor-map.html): Street map of Noyo Harbor in Fort Bragg, California coast

## Geographic Reference Maps

- [Santa Clara Location On The California Map](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/santa-clara/santa-clara-location-on-the-california-map.html): Geographic reference showing Santa Clara's location in California
- [Chula Vista Location On The California Map](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/chula-vista/chula-vista-location-on-the-california-map.html): Geographic map showing Chula Vista's location in California
- [San Mateo Location On The California Map](https://ontheworldmap.com/usa/city/san-mateo/san-mateo-location-on-the-california-map.html): Geographic reference map showing San Mateo in California
